four_signals.note: MEASURED, NOT ADJUDICATED. The gate fails ONLY on an UNGUARDED misroute (a menu with NO abstain signal on either channel). The PRD-3.1 contract gap (a scored menu printed ABOVE the warning, where 3.1 says 'MATCHES: none') and the C-3 gap (the fallback is PRINTED, never RUN) are REPORTED as contract divergences for TO-2's owner to rule on. They are not mine to convict on.

headline.metric: zero-score rate on REAL agent questions (LABEL-FREE)

TWO_NAMED_METRICS_NOT_AN_ERROR_BAR.everything_it_is_asked_means: Of EVERYTHING comp-which is ASKED, what has no catalog vocabulary? Includes HUD-injected glob patterns (comp-tool-hud.sh:291).
TWO_NAMED_METRICS_NOT_AN_ERROR_BAR.natural_language_questions_means: Of NATURAL-LANGUAGE QUESTIONS AGENTS ASKED, what has none? THE COVERAGE HOLE PROPER -- what the metric actually claims to mean.
TWO_NAMED_METRICS_NOT_AN_ERROR_BAR.DO_NOT_AVERAGE: These answer DIFFERENT QUESTIONS. They are not bounds on each other and there is no true value between them. A reader WILL average a bracket, so this is not presented as one.

headline.glob_patterns_are_a_correct_abstain_misc: '**/*COMPASSURANCE*' HAS a right answer -- comp-glob. A glob scoring zero on the curated rules and falling through to the primitive is THE FALLBACK WORKING AS DESIGNED. Counting it as a coverage hole SCORES A SUCCESS AS A FAILURE.
headline.MONOTONIC_DRIFT_WARNING: The correction sequence is 2.40x -> 1.87x -> 1.84x -> 1.59x. EVERY correction moved the SAME WAY. A random error process corrects in BOTH directions; a MONOTONIC sequence is the signature of a systematic bias still only partly uncovered. DO NOT TREAT 1.59x AS A FLOOR. Further contamination, if found, is LIKELIER TO SHRINK THIS THAN TO GROW IT.
headline.fourth_contaminant_CONFIRMED_NOT_REMOVED: Agents' own gibberish + off-domain probes survive in cohort R ('phhpk cpeaj djfkc', 'banana bread recipe'). An exact-token strip CANNOT catch GENERATED gibberish -- it is unpredictable by construction. Found by reading 25 random strings; 2/25 (~8%), NOT quoted as a point estimate.
headline.rule: Cohort C is NOT the headline. Quote the named metric, never a digit you did not re-derive.

positive_isolated.q: what breaks if I change this function

no_pollution.method: AN ALIBI BEATS A DENIAL (v4). --route-only is rail-silent by design (comp-which:793), so the sweep must leave the mirror rail EMPTY -- and an empty file only counts as silence because the POSITIVE CONTROL (one non-route-only invocation in the mirror) proves the capture path works. Every write the binary can make lands in the mirror; the sweep made none. Immune to concurrency: never looks at the shared file to decide.
no_pollution.unattributable_note: These rows are UNATTRIBUTABLE, not ours-by-proof: our probe set is drawn FROM this log, so a concurrent agent asking one of these questions is byte-identical to us writing it. Reported, never used to convict.

row_tag_tally._why: EVERY tag in the log, consumed or not, BEFORE filtering. The first cohort filter matched 'ROUTE-' and silently missed 1,487 bare-ROUTE rows from the legacy cascade -- rows that fire only on a STRONG curated match, i.e. exactly where the catalog SUCCEEDS. The filter was BIASED toward the failure it was measuring. A FILTER YOU DID NOT ENUMERATE THE COMPLEMENT OF IS A FILTER YOU HAVE NOT TESTED.
row_tag_tally.why_not_consumed: RUN-GREP/RUN-GLOB/RUN-OVERRIDE/RUN-LS are the on-rails PRIMITIVE-EXECUTION rows, not routing decisions. NOTE: RUN-GREP has TWO producers -- comp-grep logging itself when an agent calls it DIRECTLY (Rule 21 working as designed), and comp-which's own fallback. They are NOT interchangeable and must never be summed as 'abstains'.
